title: Subtraction Within 10 Worksheets
intro: Introduce subtraction by showing what is taken away and what remains.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Put out seven counters and remove three. Connect the four remaining counters to 7 − 3 = 4 before modeling counting back.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Start: ● ● ● ● ● ● ●

Take away three: ● ● ● ● ● ● ●

7 − 3 = 4

Ask your student

Which counters does the answer count?

If your student needs help

If the student counts the starting number as a backward step, model three actual moves from seven.

Choosing and using the worksheet

This set uses starting numbers from 1 to 10 and may subtract zero or the entire starting number. It does not contain negative answers or subtraction across ten. The space under each question can hold a small drawing or a number-line sketch.
